up: Return a listing of IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1980 (human sodium channel protein type 5 subunit alpha). For each qualifying activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the PubMed ID or DOI from the document, plus the assay description and the target's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and organism.
sql:
SELECT
  activities.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  assays.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs ON activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1980'
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND activities.standard_relation = '=';
